title: Super Real Mahjong PVI
overview:
All the excitement of the arcade version recreated! And on top of that...

Mini-games, additional voices, and newly drawn graphics are also included!

Super Real Mahjong PVI is an adults-only strip mahjong game for one player. After helping out an elderly mahjong master, you face the young women around him - Tamami, Yukari, Mari and Chris - in one-on-one games of mahjong, with animated scenes as your rewards for winning. An Emotion System tracks how each heroine feels about you, shown as a row of hearts. This is the limited edition release of the game.

アーケード版の興奮をすべて再現！おまけに……、

ミニゲーム、追加ボイス、描きおろしグラフィックも収録！
